definition.en: The original-currency value of guarantees newly approved, issued or accepted during a defined reporting period, using the institution's stated recognition point.
definition.zh-TW: 在明確報導期間內，依該機構所定認列時點新增核准、簽發或承作之保證原幣金額。

en: Do not substitute outstanding, cumulative, supported-loan or approved-facility amounts.
zh-TW: 不得以期末餘額、累計金額、受支持貸款額或核准額替代。

notes.en: Record whether the official source uses approval, issuance or acceptance.
notes.zh-TW: 須記錄官方來源採核准、簽發或承作何種認列時點。

definition.en: The original-currency guarantee liability remaining in force at a specified point in time.
definition.zh-TW: 截至特定時點仍在有效期間內之保證責任原幣餘額。

en: Do not substitute the supported loan balance or annual new guarantees.
zh-TW: 不得以受支持貸款餘額或當期新增保證替代。

notes.en: The as-of date is mandatory.
notes.zh-TW: 必須記錄資料基準日。

definition.en: Guarantee value accumulated from a documented starting point through an as-of date.
definition.zh-TW: 自明確起算點累積至資料基準日之保證金額。

en: Do not compare with annual new guarantees without converting both to the same period concept.
zh-TW: 未統一期間概念前，不得與年度新增保證比較。

notes.en: The cumulative starting point must be explicit.
notes.zh-TW: 必須明確記錄累計起算點。

definition.en: The number of guarantee units recognised during a period or at a point in time, with the unit explicitly identified as cases, facilities or loans.
definition.zh-TW: 在特定期間或時點認列之保證單位數，並明確標示為案件、授信額度或貸款。

en: Cases, facilities, loans and enterprises are not interchangeable.
zh-TW: 案件、授信額度、貸款與企業數不得混用。

notes.en: Unit semantics are mandatory.
notes.zh-TW: 必須記錄計數單位的實質意義。

definition.en: The count of distinct enterprises benefiting from guarantee or related support within a stated period or as of a stated date.
definition.zh-TW: 在明確期間內或截至特定日期，受保證或相關支援之不重複企業數。

en: Do not use guarantee cases as enterprise counts; document deduplication.
zh-TW: 不得以保證件數代替企業數，並須記錄去重方式。

notes.en: Distinct-beneficiary logic must be documented.
notes.zh-TW: 須記錄不重複受益對象的計算方式。

definition.en: The guaranteed portion of an eligible credit exposure under a specified scheme and date.
definition.zh-TW: 特定方案及日期下，符合資格授信曝險中由保證承擔之比例。

numeratorDefinition.en: Guaranteed amount or guaranteed loss share defined by the scheme.
numeratorDefinition.zh-TW: 方案所定保證金額或保證損失分擔額。

denominatorDefinition.en: Eligible loan, facility or loss exposure defined by the scheme.
denominatorDefinition.zh-TW: 方案所定符合資格貸款、授信額度或損失曝險。

en: Portfolio coverage, individual maximum coverage and loss-share rates may differ.
zh-TW: 組合保證成數、個案最高成數與損失分擔率可能不同。

notes.en: Preserve scheme, minimum, maximum, standard and exceptional rates.
notes.zh-TW: 須保存方案、最低、最高、標準及例外成數。

definition.en: The maximum guarantee amount allowed per borrower, loan, enterprise or programme under stated rules.
definition.zh-TW: 依明確規則按借款人、貸款、企業或方案計算之最高保證金額。

en: Per-borrower, per-loan and programme ceilings are not equivalent.
zh-TW: 每一借款人、每筆貸款及方案上限並不等同。

notes.en: Original currency and ceiling basis are mandatory.
notes.zh-TW: 必須保存原始幣別與上限計算基礎。

definition.en: The price charged for guarantee coverage under a specified scheme, fee basis and date.
definition.zh-TW: 特定方案、費率基礎及日期下，取得信用保證所支付之價格。

numeratorDefinition.en: Guarantee fee charged for the stated fee period or event.
numeratorDefinition.zh-TW: 特定計費期間或事件所收取之保證費。

denominatorDefinition.en: Guaranteed amount, loan amount or other official fee base.
denominatorDefinition.zh-TW: 保證金額、貸款金額或其他官方計費基礎。

en: Annual, one-off, risk-based, fixed, subsidised and programme-specific fees differ.
zh-TW: 年費、一次性、風險差別、固定、補貼及方案別費率不同。

notes.en: Fee basis and subsidy treatment are mandatory.
notes.zh-TW: 必須記錄計費基礎及補貼處理方式。

definition.en: The original-currency amount paid during a period under the institution's official claim, subrogation, payout or indemnification terminology.
definition.zh-TW: 在特定期間內，依機構官方所稱代償、理賠、保證給付或補償所支付之原幣金額。

en: Preserve the official term; claim approval and cash payment may differ.
zh-TW: 須保存官方原始名詞；核准理賠與實際現金支付可能不同。

notes.en: Original terminology is mandatory.
notes.zh-TW: 必須保存官方原始名詞。

definition.en: A ratio reported by an institution using its stated claim numerator and exposure denominator; no universal formula is assumed.
definition.zh-TW: 依機構明確公布之代償分子與曝險分母計算的比率，不預設統一公式。

numeratorDefinition.en: Institution-reported claims, payouts or subrogation amount or count.
numeratorDefinition.zh-TW: 機構公布之代償、給付或理賠金額或件數。

denominatorDefinition.en: Institution-reported guarantee flow, exposure, balance or other official base.
denominatorDefinition.zh-TW: 機構公布之保證流量、曝險、餘額或其他官方基礎。

en: Claim rate is not NPL ratio, default rate or delinquency ratio.
zh-TW: 代償率不等於逾放比率、違約率或逾期率。

notes.en: Both numerator and denominator must reproduce the official formula.
notes.zh-TW: 分子與分母均須忠實重現官方公式。

definition.en: An institution-specific default, non-performing loan or delinquency measure preserved under its original definition.
definition.zh-TW: 依機構原始定義保存之違約、逾期放款或延滯衡量指標。

numeratorDefinition.en: Exposure meeting the institution's official default, NPL or delinquency rule.
numeratorDefinition.zh-TW: 符合機構官方違約、逾放或延滯定義之曝險。

denominatorDefinition.en: Portfolio base used in the institution's official calculation.
denominatorDefinition.zh-TW: 機構官方計算所採用之組合分母。

en: NPL ratio, default rate, delinquency ratio and claim rate are distinct.
zh-TW: 逾放比率、違約率、逾期率與代償率各不相同。

notes.en: Use descriptively unless definitions are demonstrably aligned.
notes.zh-TW: 除非定義確實一致，僅作描述性使用。

definition.en: The original-currency amount recovered during a defined period after claim or guarantee payment.
definition.zh-TW: 在明確期間內，於代償或保證給付後追償收回之原幣金額。

en: Do not mix cash recovery with write-offs, collateral proceeds or accounting reversals unless defined.
zh-TW: 未有定義時，不得混入呆帳沖銷、擔保品處分或會計迴轉。

notes.en: Recovery components must be documented.
notes.zh-TW: 須記錄追償收回的組成項目。

definition.en: Recovery proceeds divided by the institution's explicitly stated recovery base.
definition.zh-TW: 追償收回金額除以機構明確公布之追償計算基礎。

numeratorDefinition.en: Recovery proceeds recognised under the official method.
numeratorDefinition.zh-TW: 依官方方法認列之追償收回額。

denominatorDefinition.en: Claims paid, recoverable rights, opening recovery stock or other official base.
denominatorDefinition.zh-TW: 代償額、可追償債權、期初追償存量或其他官方基礎。

en: Different recovery denominators produce different rates.
zh-TW: 不同追償分母會產生不同追償率。

notes.en: The denominator is mandatory.
notes.zh-TW: 分母為必要欄位。

definition.en: A ratio of guarantee exposure to a defined capital, fund or reserve base, used only when the official formula and compatible inputs are documented.
definition.zh-TW: 保證曝險除以明確資本、基金或準備基礎之比率，僅在官方公式及相容資料完整時使用。

denominatorDefinition.en: Officially defined capital, fund, endowment or reserve base.
denominatorDefinition.zh-TW: 官方定義之資本、基金、捐助財產或準備基礎。

en: Do not self-calculate from incompatible exposure and capital concepts.
zh-TW: 不得以不相容的曝險及資本概念自行推算。

notes.en: No derived value without a documented formula.
notes.zh-TW: 未有明確公式不得自行衍生數值。

definition.en: An institution's original-currency paid-in capital, authorised capital, endowment, guarantee reserve or fund balance, with the capital concept preserved.
definition.zh-TW: 以原始幣別保存之實收資本、授權資本、捐助財產、保證準備或基金餘額，並保留資本概念。

en: Paid-in capital, authorised capital, endowment, reserve and fund balance differ.
zh-TW: 實收資本、授權資本、捐助財產、準備及基金餘額不同。

notes.en: Never replace the original official value with a converted value.
notes.zh-TW: 不得以換算值取代原始官方數值。

definition.en: An original-currency government capital subscription, annual contribution, cumulative contribution or subsidy, with the contribution type preserved.
definition.zh-TW: 以原始幣別保存之政府認購資本、年度撥補、累計出資或補貼，並保留出資類型。

en: Annual, cumulative, subscription and subsidy amounts are not interchangeable.
zh-TW: 年度、累計、資本認購及補貼金額不得混用。

notes.en: Contribution type and time basis are mandatory.
notes.zh-TW: 必須記錄出資類型與時間基準。

definition.en: The number of distinct partner institutions at a stated date, classified by bank, cooperative, credit union, NBFI or rural institution type.
definition.zh-TW: 截至特定日期之不重複合作機構數，並按銀行、合作社、信用合作社、非銀行金融機構或農村金融機構分類。

en: Branches, legal entities and signed agreements may produce different counts.
zh-TW: 分行、法人機構及簽約件數可能產生不同計數。

notes.en: Entity and network-unit definitions must be explicit.
notes.zh-TW: 須明確定義法人與網絡單位。

definition.en: The share of activity attributed to officially defined SMEs or MSMEs using a documented activity denominator.
definition.zh-TW: 依官方中小企業或中小微企業定義，以明確業務分母計算之占比。

numeratorDefinition.en: Activity attributed to the official SME or MSME population.
numeratorDefinition.zh-TW: 歸屬於官方中小企業或中小微企業範圍之業務量。

denominatorDefinition.en: Total activity measured on the same amount, count and period basis.
denominatorDefinition.zh-TW: 以相同金額、件數及期間基礎計算之總業務量。

en: National SME definitions and activity denominators differ.
zh-TW: 各國中小企業定義及業務分母不同。

notes.en: Preserve the national SME definition.
notes.zh-TW: 須保存各國中小企業定義。

definition.en: A structured description or measure of guarantee activity explicitly classified as agricultural by the institution or governing programme.
definition.zh-TW: 由機構或主管方案明確分類為農業之保證業務描述或衡量值。

en: Not every institution has an agriculture mandate or compatible sector taxonomy.
zh-TW: 並非所有機構具有農業任務或相容的產業分類。

notes.en: Absence may mean non-applicability, not missing performance.
notes.zh-TW: 未提供可能是不適用，不代表績效缺漏。

name.zh-TW: 綠色／永續信用保證業務

definition.en: The existence or scale of a guarantee programme classified under a documented green, climate or ESG taxonomy.
definition.zh-TW: 依明確綠色、氣候或 ESG 分類法認定之保證方案存在狀態或業務規模。

en: Programme existence, guarantee amount and beneficiary count are separate observations.
zh-TW: 方案存在、保證金額及受益對象數是不同觀察值。

notes.en: Taxonomy and reporting year are mandatory.
notes.zh-TW: 必須記錄分類法及報導年度。

definition.en: The institution-reported average elapsed time for a defined application or claim process and service channel.
definition.zh-TW: 機構公布之特定申請或理賠流程及服務通路平均經過時間。

numeratorDefinition.en: Total elapsed processing time for included cases.
numeratorDefinition.zh-TW: 納入案件之總處理經過時間。

en: Application, approval, issuance and claim processing times differ.
zh-TW: 申請、核准、簽發及理賠處理時間不同。

notes.en: Process boundaries and service channel are mandatory.
notes.zh-TW: 必須記錄流程起訖與服務通路。
